title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user whose role grants system_settings:view but not assets:view…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with the system_settings:view permission but without assets:view permission could access sensitive asset and application inventory data, tenant identifiers, connector run messages, and stored configuration snapshots via the ingestion status REST API. This occurs because the API enforces system_settings:view permission but does not enforce assets:view permission or tenant restrictions when returning asset-derived ingestion records.
